adminPage.aboutOffText: Turning one off closes it for everyone at once, and the bridge app is refused until you turn it on again. Remove takes an old bridge off the list and frees its place; if it is still running, it comes back the next time someone opens it. A bridge nobody opened for 30 days stops counting toward anyone's bridges by itself.
adminPage.aboutPageText: Here you choose who may sign in and who may save projects online (in their own Google Drive), and see how close the site is to Cloudflare's free limits. People who are allowed notice nothing.
adminPage.addSomeone: Add someone to the list (their Google email)
adminPage.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} and everything they saved here (project list, presets, printers, bridges)? Their project files stay in their Google Drive. This can't be undone. They can sign up again later unless the site is invite only.
adminPage.everyBridge: Every bridge someone reached a printer through.
adminPage.intro: Only you see this page. Changes save on their own.
adminPage.inviteOnlyOff: Anyone with a Google account can sign in. Turning this on keeps everyone who already has an account.
adminPage.inviteOnlyOn: Only people on the list can sign in. Anyone else sees "Cloud Slicer is invite only for now".
adminPage.overLimit: Over a daily limit, that part stops until 00:00 UTC; nothing is charged on the free plan.
adminPage.perPersonNote: One bridge reaches every printer on its network, so most people need one. A lower number stops new bridges; ones already in use keep working. You can give one person a different number under People (0 = no bridges).
adminPage.saveFailed: That change didn't save, so this shows what's saved: {{error}}
adminPage.storageNote: Presets and printers always save to the account. Projects save to each person’s own Google Drive, so they use none of the site’s space. Each person can use as many bridges as Bridges per person says (below), and watch 2 cameras at a time through a bridge.
adminPage.title: Admin
adminPage.tokenNeeded: Today's request counts (site, relay, database) need a read-only Cloudflare token. In Cloudflare: My Profile, API Tokens, Create Token, "Read analytics and logs" template. Add it on GitHub as the repository secret
adminPage.tokenNeededEnd: ; the next deploy picks it up.
